summary.en: Translation app (有道翻譯) with an arm64 build in the Microsoft Store; Linaro lists it as native Arm64.
summary.zh-TW: 有道翻譯，Microsoft Store 提供 arm64 版本；Linaro 列為原生 Arm64。

evidence.title: Linaro Works on WoA record: 网易有道翻译(arm64), native, from 10.1.2

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general (validated on Qualcomm hardware, last updated 2026-03-02); RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm（於 Qualcomm 硬體驗證，最後更新 2026-03-02），未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
